title: Sonny and the Hidden Star | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka watches one playful star that keeps hiding behind a thin cloud and peeking back out, playing its own slow game of hide-and-seek with the whole night sky. A gentle bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
Sunny had counted nineteen stars when she noticed the one that kept disappearing.

She was lying on her back in the long grass, counting stars the way she sometimes counted her breaths when she wanted to feel sleepy.

One star in particular was right in the centre of her view. Bright enough to notice. Round enough to feel familiar.

And then it was gone.

She waited.

It came back. Brighter, almost, for having been away.

She watched it. A thin cloud drifted past — slow as a thought — and the star disappeared behind it. Then the cloud moved on, and the star appeared again, shining as if nothing had happened.

Hide. Appear. Hide. Appear.

Sunny smiled.

The star was playing.

Very slowly. Very gently. The most patient game of hide-and-seek ever played.

She kept watching. The cloud drifted back. The star hid. She waited. The star reappeared. She felt a small surge of happiness each time — like being surprised by something good, again and again.

She began to blink slowly, watching.

Hide. Appear.

Hide.

Appear.

Hide —

She was asleep before the star came back.

But the star came back anyway. It always does.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, hidden star. Goodnight, little one.
